name: Lotus Co-operative Bank
greeting: Welcome to Lotus Co-operative Bank. How can I help with your error today?
support_hours: open 10 AM to 6 PM, Monday to Saturday
_note: Fictional bank and invented error codes for demo purposes.

entries.title: International card usage disabled
entries.cause: International transactions are disabled on your debit card.
entries.fix: Enable international usage from the Lotus mobile app, or visit your home branch with ID.

entries.title: UPI PIN attempts exceeded
entries.cause: Too many wrong UPI PIN entries temporarily blocked your UPI.
entries.fix: Wait 24 hours, or reset your UPI PIN in the app using your debit card details.

entries.title: ATM debited but cash not dispensed
entries.cause: The ATM transaction failed after your account was debited.
entries.fix: The amount is reversed automatically in 5 to 7 working days. If not, raise a complaint with the transaction ID at your branch.

entries.title: NEFT beneficiary not active
entries.cause: A newly added beneficiary needs a 30 minute activation period.
entries.fix: Wait 30 minutes after adding the beneficiary, then try the transfer again.

entries.title: Passbook update failed
entries.cause: The passbook barcode could not be read by the kiosk.
entries.fix: Ask branch staff to update it at the counter, or request a new passbook.
